0022600163.text: The 76ers (6-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) host the Bulls (1-5, 13th in the East), with Philadelphia on a three-game winning streak and 3-0 on the road, while Chicago has lost four straight and sits 4 games back in the Central. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Dailyn Swain (back soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. In the 2025-26 season series, the 76ers lost 1-2, and their most recent meeting ended with a 157-137 win in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026, while the teams have not yet played each other this season.
